question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Ephemeral
solution:
The correct answer is: **Transient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ephemeral"** means something that lasts for a very short time; fleeting or transitory. (क्षणभंगुर)
 
 
• **Example: **The beauty of a rainbow is ephemeral, disappearing as quickly as it appears.
 
 
 
• **"Transient" **refers to something that is temporary and not lasting for a long time; similar to ephemeral in nature. (अस्थायी)
 
 
• **Example: **The transient nature of life reminds us to cherish each moment.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Ephemeral' **is **'Transient'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Transient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ugly **(बदसूरत): Unpleasant or repulsive, especially in appearance.
 
 
• **Example:** The old building looked ugly with its peeling paint and broken windows.
 
 
 
• **Permanent **(स्थायी ): Lasting or intended to last or remain unchanged indefinitely.
 
 
• **Example: **She has a permanent job at the company and doesn't plan to leave.
 
 
 
• **Pleasing** (मनोहर): Giving pleasure or satisfaction.
 
 
• **Example:** The painting's colors are very pleasing to the eye.
